recentItems.title: Happy 50th Anniversary to us 🥳#stopmotion #animation #aardman #aardmananimations
recentItems.description:
50 years ago today, Sir Peter Lord and Sir David Sproxton opened Aardman. Five decades later, the studio has become an multi BAFTA and Oscar winning animation success, bringing legendary characters like Morph, Wallace and Gromit and Shaun the Sheep to millions!
 
A HUGE thank you to all of our fans across the world for making Aardman what it is today ❤️

Everyone is looking forward to Halloween on Mossy Bottom Farm - until the clumsy Farmer trashes the Flock’s beloved pumpkin patch! But when Shaun turns MAD SCIENTIST to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control. With the Farmer missing and a wild beast roaming the woods of Mossingham, all the ingredients are in place for a monstrously fun family adventure.

recentItems.title: Shaun the Sheep S7 Full Episode | Gone to the Dogs | Aardman Animations
recentItems.description:
Bitzer's Dad comes to stay but isn't impressed with how Bitzer and Shaun run the flock.

Aardman favourite Shaun the Sheep is back making mischief on Mossy Bottom Farm in it's 7th series! Filled with hilarious, heart- warming comedy. Witness high-tension drama as Bitzer puts up a new shelf, the unexpected outcome of a stuck-in-the-mud tractor, the Farmer’s calamitous attempts at beekeeping, and Shaun and Bitzer getting competitive over camping. This series also features the first ever Shaun the Sheep two-part episode – A Christmas Carol-style fable where Shaun makes an impulsive wish… with unexpected consequences. 

Watch more Shaun the Sheep on Shaun's Global Official channel: https://www.youtube.com/@ShauntheSheepOfficial

For viewers in the UK, you can find more full episodes on BBC iPlayer: https://www.bbc.co.uk/iplayer/episodes/b006z39g/shaun-the-sheep
